OilTypeEnum.title: OilTypeEnum

model.description: Lagrangian model software to use for simulation.

lon.description: Central longitude for seeding drifters. Only used if `seed_flag=="elements"`.
lon.title: Lon

lat.description: Central latitude for seeding drifters. Only used if `seed_flag=="elements"`.
lat.title: Lat

geojson.description: GeoJSON describing a polygon within which to seed drifters. To use this parameter, also have `seed_flag=="geojson"`.
geojson.title: Geojson

seed_flag.description: Method for seeding drifters. Options are "elements" or "geojson". If "elements", seed drifters at or around a single point defined by lon and lat. If "geojson", seed drifters within a polygon described by a GeoJSON object.

start_time_end.description: If used, this creates a range of start times for drifters, starting with `start_time` and ending with `start_time_end`. Drifters will be initialized linearly between the two start times.
start_time_end.title: Start Time End

time_step.description: Interval between particles updates, in minutes.
time_step.title: Time Step

time_step_output.description: Time step at which element properties are stored and eventually written to file. This must be larger than the calculation time step, and be an integer multiple of this.
time_step_output.title: Time Step Output

steps.description: Maximum number of steps. End of simulation will be start_time + steps * time_step.
steps.title: Steps

duration.description: Duration should be input as a string of ISO 8601. The length of the simulation. steps, end_time, or duration must be input by user.
duration.title: Duration

end_time.description: The end of the simulation. steps, end_time, or duration must be input by user.
end_time.title: End Time

ocean_model.description: Name of ocean model to use for driving drifter simulation.

ocean_model_local.description: Set to True to use local version of known `ocean_model` instead of remote version.
ocean_model_local.title: Ocean Model Local

do3D.description: Set to True to run drifters in 3D, by default False for most drift models.
do3D.title: Do3D

use_static_masks.description: Set to True to use static masks for known models instead of wetdry masks.
use_static_masks.title: Use Static Masks

output_file.description: Name of file to write output to. If None, default name is used.
output_file.title: Output File

output_format.description: Output file format. Options are "netcdf" or "parquet".

use_cache.description: Set to True to use cache for storing interpolators.
use_cache.title: Use Cache

stokes_drift.description: Advection elements with Stokes drift (wave orbital motion).
stokes_drift.title: Stokes Drift

z.description: Depth below sea level where elements are released. This depth is neglected if seafloor seeding is set selected.
z.title: Z

number.description: The number of elements for the simulation.
number.title: Number

interpolator_filename.description: Filename to save interpolator to or read interpolator from. Exclude suffix (which should be .pickle).
interpolator_filename.title: Interpolator Filename

export_variables.description: List of variables to export. Options available with `m.all_export_variables` for a given `drift_model`. [***REMOVED***lon***REMOVED***, ***REMOVED***lat***REMOVED***, ***REMOVED***ID***REMOVED***, ***REMOVED***status***REMOVED***, ***REMOVED***z***REMOVED***] will always be exported. Default of None means all possible variables are exported.
export_variables.title: Export Variables

plots.description: Dictionary of plots to generate using OpenDrift.
plots.title: Plots

radius.description: Radius around each lon-lat pair, within which particles will be randomly seeded.
radius.title: Radius

max_speed.description: Typical maximum speed of elements, used to estimate reader buffer size
max_speed.title: Maximum speed

use_auto_landmask.description: A built-in GSHHG global landmask is used if True, otherwise landmask is taken from reader or fallback value.
use_auto_landmask.title: Use Auto Landmask

coastline_action.description: None means that objects may also move over land. stranding means that objects are deactivated if they hit land. previous means that objects will move back to the previous location if they hit land
coastline_action.title: Coastline Action

current_uncertainty.description: Add gaussian perturbation with this standard deviation to current components at each time step
current_uncertainty.title: Current Uncertainty

wind_uncertainty.description: Add gaussian perturbation with this standard deviation to wind components at each time step.
wind_uncertainty.title: Wind Uncertainty

seed_seafloor.description: Elements are seeded at seafloor, and seeding depth (z) is neglected.
seed_seafloor.title: Seed Seafloor

diffusivitymodel.description: Algorithm/source used for profile of vertical diffusivity. Environment means that diffusivity is acquired from readers or environment constants/fallback.
diffusivitymodel.title: Diffusivity model

mixed_layer_depth.description: Fallback value for ocean_mixed_layer_thickness if not available from any reader
mixed_layer_depth.title: Mixed Layer Depth

seafloor_action.description: deactivate: elements are deactivated; lift_to_seafloor: elements are lifted to seafloor level; previous: elements are moved back to previous position; none; seafloor is ignored.
seafloor_action.title: Seafloor Action

wind_drift_depth.description: The direct wind drift (windage) is linearly decreasing from the surface value (wind_drift_factor) until 0 at this depth.
wind_drift_depth.title: Wind Drift Depth

vertical_mixing_timestep.description: Time step used for inner loop of vertical mixing.
vertical_mixing_timestep.title: Vertical Mixing Timestep

wind_drift_factor.description: Elements at surface are moved with this fraction of the wind vector, in addition to currents and Stokes drift
wind_drift_factor.title: Wind Drift Factor

vertical_mixing.description: Activate vertical mixing scheme with inner loop
vertical_mixing.title: Vertical Mixing

oil_type.description: Oil type to be used for the simulation, from the NOAA ADIOS database.
oil_type.title: Oil Type

m3_per_hour.description: The amount (volume) of oil released per hour (or total amount if release is instantaneous)
m3_per_hour.title: M3 Per Hour

droplet_size_distribution.description: Droplet size distribution used for subsea release.
droplet_size_distribution.title: Droplet Size Distribution

droplet_diameter_mu.description: The mean diameter of oil droplet for a subsea release, used in normal/lognormal distributions.
droplet_diameter_mu.title: Droplet Diameter Mu

droplet_diameter_sigma.description: The standard deviation in diameter of oil droplet for a subsea release, used in normal/lognormal distributions.
droplet_diameter_sigma.title: Droplet Diameter Sigma

droplet_diameter_min_subsea.description: The minimum diameter of oil droplet for a subsea release, used in unifrom distribution.
droplet_diameter_min_subsea.title: Droplet Diameter Min Subsea

droplet_diameter_max_subsea.description: The maximum diameter of oil droplet for a subsea release, used in uniform distribution.
droplet_diameter_max_subsea.title: Droplet Diameter Max Subsea

emulsification.description: Surface oil is emulsified, i.e. water droplets are mixed into oil due to wave mixing, with resulting increas of viscosity.
emulsification.title: Emulsification

dispersion.description: Oil is removed from simulation (dispersed), if entrained as very small droplets.
dispersion.title: Dispersion

update_oilfilm_thickness.description: Oil film thickness is calculated at each time step. The alternative is that oil film thickness is kept constant with value provided at seeding.
update_oilfilm_thickness.title: Update Oilfilm Thickness

biodegradation.description: Oil mass is biodegraded (eaten by bacteria).
biodegradation.title: Biodegradation
